In the first reaction, hydrogen and oxygen combine to form water vapor, whereas in the second, water vapor dissociates into hydrogen and oxygen. The equilibrium constants K1 and K2 are clearly the inverse of each other, so their product K1K2 5 1. This is true quite generally: The equilibrium constant for a reverse reaction is the reciprocal of the equilibrium constant for the corre- sponding forward reaction.
